2608.12894.title: BavGround: A Benchmark for Regional Cultural Grounding and Dialect Competence in Bavarian
2608.12894.paper_summary: Cultural evaluation of large language models (LLMs) often focuses on high-resource standard languages, leaving regional culture and dialect communities underrepresented. We introduce BavGround, a benchmark for evaluating Bavarian regional cultural grounding and dialect competence across English, German and Bavarian. BavGround contains 206 multiple-choice source questions across eight cultural domains per language, yielding 618 multi-parallel instances, with items covering both broadly accessible cultural knowledge and source-grounded regional knowledge from journalism, historical sources, and specialist literature. We evaluate fifteen 7B-10B open-weight instruction-tuned models and one closed-model reference. Strong multilingual models perform best overall, but performance drops on Bavarian items and source-grounded questions, indicating persistent difficulty with dialectal and localized cultural knowledge. We further show that conclusions depend strongly on evaluation protocol: raw answer-letter scoring, shuffled-letter scoring, option-text likelihood, generated-answer parsing, and semantic matching can produce different absolute scores and rankings, especially for regionally adapted models. Finally, an exploratory analysis of GENBA-10B checkpoints suggests that continued pretraining improves answer-content likelihood unevenly across domains, while dialect competence remains comparatively weak. BavGround supports localized, protocol-aware evaluation of cultural representation in LLMs.
2608.12894.paper_summary_zh: 文化評估大型語言模型（LLMs）時，通常集中於高資源的標準語言，導致地區文化和方言社群未受到充分代表。我們介紹了BavGround，這是一個用於評估巴伐利亞地區文化基礎和方言能力的基準，涵蓋英語、德語和巴伐利亞語。BavGround包含每種語言206個多選題，涵蓋八個文化領域，產生618個多平行實例，題目涵蓋廣泛可及的文化知識以及來自新聞、歷史來源和專業文獻的基於來源的地區知識。我們評估了十五個7B-10B開放權重的指令調整模型和一個封閉模型參考。強大的多語言模型整體表現最佳，但在巴伐利亞題目和基於來源的問題上表現下降，顯示出對方言和本地文化知識的持續困難。我們進一步顯示結論在很大程度上取決於評估協議：原始答案字母計分、隨機字母計分、選項文本可能性、生成答案解析和語義匹配可能會產生不同的絕對分數和排名，特別是對於地區適應模型。最後，對GENBA-10B檢查點的探索性分析表明，持續的預訓練在不同領域中不均勻地改善答案內容的可能性，而方言能力仍然相對較弱。BavGround支持對LLMs中文化表現的本地化、協議意識評估。
